Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits, the follow-up damage can easily land all at once, so move with a minion wave between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the return, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path. While Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, don’t use Corki W Valkyrie recklessly to engage.
Ahri.build: Farm safely early to reach your first core item sooner. Prioritize defenses that can interrupt or remove Ahri E Charm, and build magic resistance against Ahri’s magic damage. Magic resistance doesn’t reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception, so use your health pool to absorb that portion. If healing from Ahri P Essence Theft negates your poke, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ahri.fight: Dodge Ahri E Charm from behind minions and chip away at her health with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. Once Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are down, you can close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie. Ahri has relatively low armor, so turn on Corki E Gatling Gun and weave in basic attacks to deal damage.
Ahri.laning: Follow Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb with Corki R Missile Barrage to poke, while also moving out of Ahri Q Orb of Deception’s return path. If you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Ahri.combo: When poking, reveal Ahri with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then launch Corki R Missile Barrage. For an all-in after Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are down, close in with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, and follow up with basic attacks. After Corki E Gatling Gun reduces her armor and magic resistance, time the third shot’s heavy damage to finish with Corki R Missile Barrage.
Ahri.escape: The moment Ahri E Charm goes down is your chance to engage. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is also down, she has fewer ways to create distance, so close in with Corki W Valkyrie. If both abilities are available, save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Ahri.phase: Corki is strong in the mid to late game once he has two or three items.
Ahri.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is actually attacking. If Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush are available, don’t engage first with Corki W Valkyrie. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then keep launching Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

Akali.watch: If Akali’s mark lands, her second dash will follow even if you escape with Corki W Valkyrie, so save Corki W Valkyrie to respond to an Akali R Perfect Execution engage. When Akali enters Akali W Twilight Shroud, use Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or Corki R Missile Barrage on the position where she briefly appears.
Akali.build: Farm safely early to get your first core item quickly. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Akali’s damage, and build health to account for Akali R Perfect Execution’s damage based on missing health.
Akali.fight: When Akali comes out of her shroud to attack, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun and fight back with basic attacks. If Akali still has a mobility ability available, don’t engage first with Corki W Valkyrie.
Akali.laning: Poke with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage, but if you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Akali.combo: When poking, reveal Akali’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. If Akali’s engage tools are down and you can all-in, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, attack with basic attacks, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. If possible, finish with the third, larger missile.
Akali.escape: If only Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, she still has another way to move, so don’t rush the engage. In particular, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie when Akali R Perfect Execution is not yet back and her other engage tools are down.
Akali.phase: Look for opportunities to build a health and CS lead while Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable.
Akali.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is attacking. Reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then keep launching Corki R Missile Barrage from beyond walls or outside their vision. Only engage with Corki W Valkyrie after Akali’s engage ability and other threatening crowd control are down.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range as it hits more minions, so watch for and dodge its outgoing and return paths even from behind the wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage, and its cooldown resets if he participates in a takedown. If you’re targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance while low on health, move behind terrain instead of fleeing alone into the open.
Akshan.build: Farm safely early to complete your first core item quickly. Build armor first against the main damage from Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance. Take advantage of Corki P Hextech Munitions’ true damage and Akshan’s low armor by consistently weaving in basic attacks.
Akshan.fight: From long range, hit Akshan with Corki R Missile Barrage after revealing him with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to gradually chip away at his health. The moment Akshan E Heroic Swing goes down is your chance to close the gap. If you go in with Corki W Valkyrie then, move with Corki E Gatling Gun active, attack with basic attacks, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage.
Akshan.laning: Don’t just stand behind minions to avoid Akshan Q Avengerang; watch both its outgoing and return paths. If you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Akshan.combo: Poke in this order: Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb → Corki R Missile Barrage. If you engage after Akshan E Heroic Swing goes down, follow this order: Corki W Valkyrie → basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active → Corki R Missile Barrage. Check your missile count so the third, larger Corki R Missile Barrage shot lands as the finisher.
Akshan.escape: While Akshan E Heroic Swing is available, don’t use Corki W Valkyrie to engage first. You can close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie right after Akshan uses E Heroic Swing. If you lack vision or need to escape, save Corki W Valkyrie as an escape tool.
Akshan.phase: Corki’s damage peaks in the mid to late game once he has two or three items, so deal damage from a safe position.
Akshan.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is actually attacking. Secure vision near terrain and brush where Akshan could approach while camouflaged, and check unwarded paths with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb. If you have the villain mark, don’t face Akshan alone; fight from outside his finishing range.

Ambessa.watch: When you see Ambessa W Repudiation’s windup, stop attacking and walk out of its range. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, it’s hard to dodge the follow-up Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, so use Corki W Valkyrie immediately. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the champion farthest away in a straight line, so don’t stand in a straight line with an ally when facing her.
Ambessa.build: If Ambessa’s healing restores the health you chipped away with poke, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Choose armor when building resistance. Be careful about stacking health, since Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on the target’s max health.
Ambessa.fight: Reveal Ambessa’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow with Corki R Missile Barrage to chip away at her health from afar. Counterattack right after Ambessa has spent her abilities and all charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Don’t attack during the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation.
Ambessa.laning: If you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Ambessa.combo: Poke in this order: reveal Ambessa with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. For an all-in after Ambessa’s engage tools and crowd control are down, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, attack with basic attacks, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Time the third missile’s heavy damage to finish her.
Ambessa.escape: The moment Ambessa’s abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges are spent is your chance to engage. If Ambessa R Public Execution or her other engage and crowd control abilities are available, don’t use Corki W Valkyrie first. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, escape immediately with Corki W Valkyrie.
Ambessa.phase: In the mid to late game, once Corki has two or three items, deal poke and teamfight damage from the backline.
Ambessa.teamfight: Use Corki R Missile Barrage from behind, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun toward the target your allies are actually attacking. Use Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to check areas without vision, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage from beyond walls or outside enemy vision. Don’t stand at the end of Ambessa R Public Execution’s line, and don’t use Corki W Valkyrie to engage before Ambessa’s engage and crowd control abilities are down.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost detonates at its recast location and stuns, so watch its blast radius and stay out of range from the start. If you’re hit by Q or chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so use Corki W Valkyrie to get out of the storm immediately. In narrow passages, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.
Anivia.build: Anivia’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Anivia P Rebirth can restore the health you’ve chipped away, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Anivia.fight: Reveal her with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage, chipping away at her health from maximum range. You can close the distance after Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, and the window after Anivia P Rebirth has been used is a kill opportunity. If you need to make sure you destroy the egg, go in with an ally.
Anivia.laning: When you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Anivia.combo: To poke, reveal Anivia with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. To engage, use Corki W Valkyrie to close the distance, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Time the powerful third missile to hit as you finish her off.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility, but watch out for the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost and the path block from Anivia W Crystallize. Try to engage with Corki W Valkyrie only after her crowd control is down; until then, save it for escape. If you’re hit by Q or trapped inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, use W to get out and break Anivia E Frostbite’s follow-up.
Anivia.phase: Corki is weak early because his base stats are low, so prioritize farming without taking losses.
Anivia.teamfight: From the backline, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then deal damage with Corki R Missile Barrage. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your ally is actually attacking to reduce its armor and magic resistance. Avoid narrow passages where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and only try to engage with Corki W Valkyrie after the enemy’s engage tools and crowd control are down.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health and stacks Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its line of fire. When your health is low, don’t enter Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you; if you get caught, move outward immediately. In the late game, spread out so several teammates aren’t hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend together.
AurelionSol.build: The starting item isn’t specified in the source. Since Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, consider magic resistance first when building resistances. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, so be careful about choosing items that add a lot of health alone.
AurelionSol.fight: Reveal him with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage, chipping away at his health from maximum range. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, you can counterattack by closing the distance with Corki W Valkyrie. Corki W Valkyrie is your only mobility tool, so save it when you may need to escape.
AurelionSol.combo: To poke, reveal his position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down and you can safely get close, engage with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. The third missile deals heavy damage, so count your shots and time it to finish him off.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used is an opportunity to close the distance with Corki W Valkyrie. However, after using Corki W Valkyrie, you have few ways to escape, so engage only when you can avoid the crowd control from Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol grows stronger as Stardust stacks permanently, so avoid unnecessary skill hits from the start and limit his opportunities to scale.
AurelionSol.teamfight: From the backline, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and deal damage safely with Corki R Missile Barrage. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your ally is actually attacking to reduce its armor and magic resistance. Spread out so you aren’t all hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend in the late game, and engage with Corki W Valkyrie only after the enemy’s engage tools and crowd control are down.

Annie.watch: When you see that Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, stay out of Annie’s ability range. Spread out so several teammates aren’t hit by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, and don’t stay near the summoned Tibbers.
Annie.build: Farm safely early to reach your first core item sooner. Get enough magic resistance to withstand Annie’s magic damage, but don’t rely on resistance alone, considering that Annie R Summon: Tibbers can pierce through. Also consider tenacity and movement speed to reduce situations where Annie P Pyromania’s stun leaves you locked down and hit by all her abilities.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, poke from long range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. If Annie uses her stun, that’s a chance to pressure her; weave in basic attacks empowered by Corki P Hextech Munitions as well. Don’t chase recklessly when Annie E Molten Shield grants a shield and increased movement speed.
Annie.laning: Annie has relatively short range, so keep your distance and poke with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. When you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Annie.combo: To poke, reveal Annie’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. If you engage after Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, close the distance with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. The third missile deals heavy damage, so count your shots and time it to finish her off.
Annie.escape: Annie has no mobility, so the moment after she uses Annie P Pyromania’s stun is an opportunity to go in with Corki W Valkyrie.
Annie.phase: In the mid to late game, when you have two or three items, make use of Corki’s power spike and deal damage while keeping your distance.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, don’t stand clumped up with your allies. Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again on its return, and that damage increases as your health drops. If you’re cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora, and retreat before the return if your health is low. Escape before Aurora R Between Worlds unfolds, or be ready to fight inside the zone.
Aurora.build: Farm safely early to reach your first core item sooner. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing erases your poke damage, buy Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Aurora’s damage.
Aurora.fight: Hit her with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb from maximum range and poke with Corki R Missile Barrage. If Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds is still available, don’t jump in first with Corki W Valkyrie. Look for an engage when her mobility is down and Aurora can’t contribute to a takedown.
Aurora.laning: When you lack vision, don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Aurora.combo: To poke, reveal her position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. When an engage window opens, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage.
Aurora.escape: If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds is down, she can use the others to escape, so don’t rush your engage. In particular, close the distance with Corki W Valkyrie during a window when her other mobility tools are down, before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back. Until then, save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Aurora.phase: The source alone doesn’t establish when Aurora is strong or weak, so at every stage, check whether her mobility tools are down before fighting.
Aurora.teamfight: From the backline, reveal Aurora’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and deal damage safely with Corki R Missile Barrage. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your ally is actually attacking to reduce its armor and magic resistance. Aurora can use her leap again if she contributes to a takedown, so don’t leave low-health allies behind, and engage with Corki W Valkyrie only after Aurora’s engage tool is down.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you are poisoned, so move out of range and fight again once the poison ends. You cannot use Corki W Valkyrie inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so do not step on the clouds. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze's cast animation, turn away to avoid being stunned.
Cassiopeia.build: Farm safely early and get your first core item quickly. If Cassiopeia E Twin Fang's healing erases your poke damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Cassiopeia Q, W, and E deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance when building defenses.
Cassiopeia.fight: Poke from max range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, keep your distance until the poison ends. Watch for Cassiopeia W Miasma and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, and use Corki W Valkyrie to close the gap when an opening appears.
Cassiopeia.laning: Cassiopeia has low armor, so you can pressure her with basic attacks and short trades from a safe distance. Do not push the lane toward her turret when you lack vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Cassiopeia.combo: To poke, reveal her position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then cast Corki R Missile Barrage. When you have an opening to engage, use Corki W Valkyrie to go in and lay down the flames, then keep attacking with Corki E Gatling Gun active before finishing with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your launches so the high-damage third missile finishes her.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so use Corki W Valkyrie to engage after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is down. If W Miasma is already on the ground, do not cast W Valkyrie over it; take a path that avoids the clouds.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage is also threatening in the mid to late game if she doesn’t build an early lead, so don’t fight her head-on for long.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually attacking. Look to engage right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere, but watch for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then cast Corki R Missile Barrage from beyond a wall or outside their vision.

Azir.watch: Avoid the attack range of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise!, and watch for a slow after Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide can push away your engage, so do not use Corki W Valkyrie to dive in first.
Azir.build: Farm safely early and get your first core item quickly. If you build resistance against Azir's magic damage, choose magic resistance over armor. No specific first purchase is provided.
Azir.fight: Reveal his position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage for a short trade. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers, when they have stopped and Azir E Shifting Sands is down, use Corki W Valkyrie to close the gap. Keep trades short and forceful, since the soldiers will keep damaging you if you trade for too long.
Azir.laning: Avoid the straight lines where his soldiers stand, and pressure him when the soldiers expire or Azir runs low on mana. Do not push the lane toward Azir's turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Azir.combo: To poke, reveal Azir with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. When an opening to engage appears, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your launches so the large third missile finishes him.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands is used is your opening to close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, it can push you away, so do not rush your engage. After using Corki W Valkyrie, you have few ways to escape, so save it for escape when you cannot engage.
Azir.phase: Azir also grows stronger as the game goes on, so finish fights quickly when an opportunity appears.
Azir.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually attacking. Do not all engage at once in narrow passages where Azir R Emperor's Divide is dangerous. Before an objective, reveal the enemy's position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then keep casting Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies and leaves a mark, so dodge sideways instead of only retreating. If the mark hits you, Diana can recast Diana E Lunar Rush, so be ready to use Corki W Valkyrie to create distance. Stay spread out from your allies so Diana R Moonfall does not pull several of you in together.
Diana.build: Farm safely and get your first core item quickly. If you need resistance against Diana's damage, choose magic resistance. No specific first purchase is provided.
Diana.fight: Poke from max range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. Start trading after Diana W Pale Cascade's orbs and shield are gone. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, keep your distance and be ready for Diana E Lunar Rush to re-engage.
Diana.laning: Do not push the lane toward the enemy turret when you lack vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Diana.combo: To poke, reveal Diana's position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. Once her engage tool is down and you have an angle, approach with Corki W Valkyrie and keep attacking with Corki E Gatling Gun active. Time Corki R Missile Barrage's third, empowered shot to finish her.
Diana.escape: Right after Diana E Lunar Rush is used is an opportunity to approach, but use Corki W Valkyrie only after accounting for Diana's ability to re-engage. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, E may reset, so do not go in; create distance. In a team fight, use W to engage only after Diana's engage and crowd control are down.
Diana.phase: In the mid and late game, once you have two or three items, use Corki's strengths to deal damage from the back.
Diana.teamfight: Use vision to check Diana's flanking route, and stay spread out from your allies so Diana R Moonfall does not pull you in together. Use Corki R Missile Barrage from the back, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. Hold Corki W Valkyrie for after Diana's engage and crowd control are down.

Galio.watch: When Galio W Shield of Durand charges, he takes less damage and the taunt lasts longer, so do not use your damage; move out of range. Dodge when you see Galio E Justice Punch pull back, and avoid the point where Galio Q Winds of War's gusts overlap. Immediately leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.build: Prioritize safe farming over early kills to get your first core item quickly. Against Galio's main damage, choose magic resistance over armor. Avoid choices that only add a lot of health, since Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on your max health.
Galio.fight: From max range, reveal his position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then poke with Corki R Missile Barrage. Stop trading while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging and move out of taunt range. Close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie only after Galio E Justice Punch and Galio R Hero's Entrance are down.
Galio.laning: Galio is melee and uses a lot of mana, so use ranged poke to make him spend abilities clearing the wave. When he is low on mana, push the lane to limit his chance to use Galio R Hero's Entrance to affect other lanes. Do not push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Galio.combo: To poke, reveal Galio with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. When an opening to engage appears, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your missiles so the high damage from the third one finishes him.
Galio.escape: Do not engage with Corki W Valkyrie just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Wait until Galio R Hero's Entrance is also unavailable and you have avoided the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand. Until then, save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Galio.phase: Even early, when Galio has low armor, pressure him with poke that includes basic attacks instead of a reckless all-in.
Galio.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. Leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, and do not use Corki W Valkyrie to engage before Galio's engage and taunt are down. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then cast Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

Ekko.watch: When Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s marker appears, move outside the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Dodge Ekko Q Timewinder’s return path, and don’t chase recklessly when you see the afterimage of Ekko R Chronobreak, even if he’s low on health.
Ekko.build: Farm safely to reach your first core item sooner. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing lets him shrug off your poke, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance against Ekko’s magic damage. If you don’t have Corki W Valkyrie and can’t easily avoid the stun, prioritize tenacity.
Ekko.fight: Poke from maximum range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage, weaving in basic attacks. Don’t engage just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down; wait until Ekko R Chronobreak is down too.
Ekko.laning: Don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape. Watch for Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s marker and Ekko Q Timewinder’s return path to maintain your distance.
Ekko.combo: To poke, reveal Ekko’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. Once Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, engage with Corki W Valkyrie. Turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Time the third, high-damage missile to finish him.
Ekko.escape: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun zone and engage when both Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. Until then, save Corki W Valkyrie to respond to Ekko’s engage.
Ekko.phase: At any stage of the game, look for a fight when Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.teamfight: Deal damage from the back line with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage from beyond a wall or outside vision. Don’t use Corki W Valkyrie to engage until Ekko’s engage ability and Ekko W Parallel Convergence are down.

Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used to engage or disengage, so don’t go deep before it’s down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters’ fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark explodes. Fizz can follow the shark with Q Urchin Strike, so save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Fizz.build: Secure CS safely and complete your first core item quickly. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Fizz’s main damage, so choose magic resistance if you’re building defenses.
Fizz.fight: Hit Fizz with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb from maximum range, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage while he’s revealed. Only close the distance with Corki W Valkyrie after confirming Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down too.

Don’t leave the lane pushed toward the enemy turret when you lack vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape. Look to trade right after Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered basic attack from W Seastone Trident or uses E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.combo: To poke, reveal Fizz with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. If his mobility ability is down and you can all-in, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. When possible, count your shots so the third, high-damage missile lands at the finish.
Fizz.escape: Go in when both Fizz Q Urchin Strike and E Playful / Trickster are down, and you can avoid the crowd control from Fizz R Chum the Waters. If only one mobility ability is down, he can still disengage with the other, so don’t use Corki W Valkyrie first.
Fizz.phase: Corki is strong in the mid to late game as he builds two or three items, so get through the early game safely to reach that point sooner.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies, bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him down. Reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage from the back line or beyond a wall. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are hitting, and delay engaging with Corki W Valkyrie until Fizz’s engage and crowd control are down.

If Hwei’s first spell hits you, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. If Hwei E Subject: Torment was just used to poke or clear the wave, that’s an opportunity to close the distance with Corki W Valkyrie. Until then, save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.

Hwei.combo: To poke, reveal Hwei’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage. When all-inning after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, engage with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your shots so the third Corki R Missile Barrage, which deals heavy damage, lands at the finish.

Hwei.phase: Take advantage of Corki’s strong mid to late game when you have two or three items.
Hwei.teamfight: Deal damage from the back line with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually hitting. Don’t engage with Corki W Valkyrie while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available. Before an objective, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage from beyond a wall or outside vision.

Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and save Corki W Valkyrie. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and back away when minions are close to dying. Farm safely instead of forcing an early kill, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape. Don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision.
Irelia.combo: To poke, reveal Irelia’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. When there’s a safe window to engage, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Time the third, high-damage missile to finish her.

Deal damage from the back line with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually hitting. Before engaging with Corki W Valkyrie, make sure Irelia’s engage and crowd control are down.

Katarina.watch: If Katarina Q Bouncing Blade hits you, the dagger lands behind you, so step back and avoid standing on it. Katarina E Shunpo can reach the dagger, so keep clear of where it lands. When Katarina R Death Lotus starts, move out of range to avoid its damage and healing reduction.

With your team, stay clear of Katarina’s daggers and protect low-health allies to prevent a first takedown. Save your team’s immobilizing crowd control to interrupt Katarina R Death Lotus, and only engage with Corki W Valkyrie after enemy engage abilities such as Katarina E Shunpo are used.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame is dangerous because of its slow and area damage, so dodge it from behind minions or outside its range. If you’re hit by the circle left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, walk out before it explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.
Karma.build: Farm safely early to get your first core item sooner. If the magic damage from Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve is a problem, build magic resistance first. If Karma R Mantra-empowered W restores the health you removed with poke, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Karma.fight: Dodge Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve, then whittle her down with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb followed by Corki R Missile Barrage. Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended. If Karma R Mantra-empowered E has shielded nearby allies, delay your burst.
Karma.laning: When you lack vision, don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Karma.combo: Poke by revealing her with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hitting her with Corki R Missile Barrage. When you have an opening to engage, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Track your charges so the third, Big One cast of Corki R Missile Barrage lands as the finisher.
Karma.escape: If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, going in first with Corki W Valkyrie can get you rooted, so engage after it’s used. Look for an opening after Karma E Inspire or Karma R Mantra-empowered E’s shield ends as well. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance before it roots you. If there’s no opening to engage, save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Karma.phase: Corki peaks in the mid to late game as he builds two or three items, so focus your damage after Karma’s shield ends then, too.
Karma.teamfight: Deal damage from the back line with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. Don’t engage with Corki W Valkyrie while Karma W Focused Resolve is available or Karma R Mantra-empowered E’s shield is active. At objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then keep casting Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Corki W Valkyrie to get beyond its range before the root takes hold. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, don’t rush your abilities; check which one is actually attacking.

Leblanc.fight: Whittle her down by revealing her with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then following with Corki R Missile Barrage. Counterattack after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has already been used. Until then, don’t use Corki W Valkyrie to engage; save it to escape LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains.
Leblanc.laning: Prioritize safe CS over kills early, and poke from maximum range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. When you lack vision, don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc pushes the lane and disappears from vision.
Leblanc.combo: When poking, reveal LeBlanc with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. If LeBlanc W Distortion’s return has ended and LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down, go in with Corki W Valkyrie and weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active. Land the third, Big One cast of Corki R Missile Barrage as the finisher.
Leblanc.escape: The window to engage with Corki W Valkyrie opens after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has been used, and LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains has hit you, don’t engage; use Corki W Valkyrie to get beyond its range before the root takes hold.

Kassadin.watch: Watch out for Kassadin’s engage: he closes the gap with Kassadin R Riftwalk, then slows you with Kassadin E Force Pulse. Don’t use Corki W Valkyrie first; wait for Kassadin R Riftwalk, then create distance.

Kassadin.fight: Hit him with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb from long range, then trade by following the revealed position with Corki R Missile Barrage. Weave in basic attacks, and only close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down.
Kassadin.laning: If you lack vision, don’t push deep. Save Corki W Valkyrie for escape and farm safely.
Kassadin.combo: Poke by revealing Kassadin with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hitting him with Corki R Missile Barrage. In a safe window while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, use Corki E Gatling Gun while weaving in basic attacks, then finish with the third, Big One cast of Corki R Missile Barrage.
Kassadin.escape: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have a window to engage with Corki W Valkyrie. Check whether the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse is down, too. If you can’t confirm both abilities are down, save Corki W Valkyrie.

Don’t stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk, and only engage with Corki W Valkyrie after Kassadin’s engage abilities are down.

Lissandra.build: Farm safely in the early game to get your first core item quickly. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Lissandra’s damage. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s healing undoes your poke, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.

If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, you can close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, don’t commit all your finishing damage at once.

Lissandra.combo: Poke by revealing her position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hitting her with Corki R Missile Barrage. After Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost are down, engage with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Time the third, larger Corki R Missile Barrage shot for the finish, but if Lissandra casts R Frozen Tomb on herself, hold your follow-up damage until her stasis ends.

Delay your engage if Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun is available. If things get dangerous, use Corki’s only mobility ability, W Valkyrie, to create distance.

Lissandra.teamfight: From the backline, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and deal damage safely with Corki R Missile Barrage. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is actually attacking. Only engage with Corki W Valkyrie after their engage tools and crowd control, including Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, are down.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her remaining abilities can easily follow, so bait it out and dodge first. Leave the slow zone from Lux E Lucent Singularity, and move sideways when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark. If Lux lands an ability, create distance so you don’t also get hit by a basic attack that triggers Lux Illumination.

Look for a chance to close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie only after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Once close, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, keep moving, and weave in basic attacks.

If Lux Q Light Binding misses and you can engage, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your shots so the high-damage third missile comes at the finish.

Don’t approach grouped with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you all together. Before an objective, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then keep firing Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits once, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid a second hit. Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals physical damage, so if you need defenses, prioritize armor and health over magic resistance. If Naafiri’s healing from Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate erases your poke advantage, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Naafiri.fight: Poke Naafiri and her pack with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb at max range, then follow with Corki R Missile Barrage. Don’t engage first with Corki W Valkyrie while Naafiri still has a mobility ability available.

Don’t give Naafiri E Eviscerate an angle to close the gap, and when you have no vision, don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret. Focus on farming safely to reach your first core item sooner instead of rushing for a kill.
Naafiri.combo: When poking, reveal her position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage. When an engage window opens, go in with Corki W Valkyrie to lay down the flames, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with R. Count your charges so the third, larger R shot comes at the finish.
Naafiri.phase: In the mid-to-late game, once you have two or three items, group up to prevent Naafiri from reaching your backline.
Naafiri.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are hitting. Clear Naafiri’s pack with the area damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or R Missile Barrage. Don’t get caught alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, and fall back after an ally dies so you don’t get picked off in succession.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting its first target, making it easy to root people standing behind them, so don’t stand directly behind an ally. Don’t chase Neeko W Shapesplitter’s clone; watch for the real Neeko’s position.

Use Corki W Valkyrie to close the gap only when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down and you can approach safely. Weave in empowered basic attacks between abilities to take advantage of Neeko's low defenses.

When you get a safe all-in opportunity, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your shots so the high-damage third missile comes at the finish.
Neeko.escape: Don’t engage first with Corki W Valkyrie while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and R Pop Blossom are available. Close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie only after both abilities are down; otherwise, save it to escape Neeko’s engage.

Watch for Neeko to transform and approach, and spread out from your allies so you aren’t all caught by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and R Pop Blossom. Save Corki W Valkyrie until Neeko’s engage tools are down. In objective fights, check her position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe spot.

Malzahar Q Call of the Void silences you and prevents Corki W Valkyrie, so when you see it cast, move outside the line between the two portals. Malzahar.fight: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then chip away at his health from max range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb followed by Corki R Missile Barrage. Don't engage first with Corki W Valkyrie while Malzahar can use Malzahar Q Call of the Void and Malzahar R Nether Grasp. When you engage, use Corki E Gatling Gun to reduce his armor and magic resistance, and weave in basic attacks.

When Malzahar P Void Shift is down and there’s no risk of being caught by Malzahar Q Call of the Void or R Nether Grasp, engage with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, and finish with R Missile Barrage. Time the third Corki R Missile Barrage launch, which deals heavy damage, to finish him.

If Malzahar has summoned Voidlings with W Void Swarm, clear them first with an area ability such as Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or R Missile Barrage. Engage with Corki W Valkyrie only after dangerous crowd control, including Malzahar Q Call of the Void and R Nether Grasp, has been used.

Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is actually attacking to reduce their armor and magic resistance. Avoid where Orianna’s ball is placed, and only try to engage with Corki W Valkyrie after the enemy’s engage tools and crowd control have been used.
