Mel E Solar Snare roots you if its center hits, so dodge to the side and save Corki W Valkyrie to avoid the root. If you’ve been hit by Mel’s attacks several times, watch out for her execute even if you still have health, and wait somewhere safe after the fight until the stacks disappear.
Mel.build: The guide does not specify a particular item to buy first. Farm safely to get your first core item quickly, and build magic resistance rather than armor against Mel’s magic damage.
Mel.fight: Chip away at her health by revealing her position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then following with Corki R Missile Barrage. Save your main projectiles until Mel W Rebuttal has been used, and look to engage during an opening after Mel E Solar Snare has also been used. Move with Corki E Gatling Gun active and weave in empowered basic attacks.
Mel.laning: Pressure Mel with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage to slow her scaling, but don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision. Save Corki W Valkyrie for gank protection.
Mel.combo: Your basic poke sequence is to reveal Mel with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. If you can go in after drawing out Mel W Rebuttal, close the distance with Corki W Valkyrie and keep up basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active. Finish with Corki R Missile Barrage’s third launch, which deals heavy damage.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so look to engage with Corki W Valkyrie after Mel W Rebuttal and Mel E Solar Snare have been used.
Mel.phase: Mel gets stronger over time, so watch out for her scaling in a long game.
Mel.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is actually attacking. Use your main projectiles carefully while Mel W Rebuttal is available; reveal the area with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage. Only look to engage with Corki W Valkyrie after Mel E Solar Snare and the enemy’s other engage tools and crowd control have been used.

Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana approaches with the river element, move out of range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal’s root. Fight in an open area, since Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can stun you when it hits terrain if you have your back to a wall. Qiyana can prepare an ambush after disappearing with the brush element, so check the brush with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and move into your team’s vision.
Qiyana.build: Farm safely early and get your first core item quickly. Build armor first against Qiyana’s main damage, and don’t build magic resistance just for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape. Avoid choices that only greatly increase your health, since Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on your max health.
Qiyana.fight: Poke from max range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage while waiting for Qiyana to engage. Right after both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity have been used, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, move while weaving in basic attacks, and fight back. Use Corki W Valkyrie then to close the distance or escape.
Qiyana.laning: Don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Qiyana.combo: To poke, hit Qiyana with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to reveal her position, then throw Corki R Missile Barrage. If her engage tools and crowd control have been used and it’s safe to go in, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, use basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your launches so the third missile comes out as you finish her.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t engage first with Corki W Valkyrie after only Qiyana W Terrashape has been used, since she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Engage after both mobility abilities are used and you can avoid the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Otherwise, save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Qiyana.phase: In the mid to late game, when you have two or three items, Corki gets stronger while Qiyana gets relatively weaker, so move with your team.
Qiyana.teamfight: Avoid fighting in narrow passages by walls and the river; fight with your team in open areas, and stay out of positions where you could be caught in Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. From behind your team, use Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to gain vision and Corki R Missile Barrage to deal damage. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking, and use Corki W Valkyrie to engage only after Qiyana's engage ability and crowd control are down.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, move away from your allies until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first.
Ryze.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Ryze Q Overload, Ryze W Rune Prison, and Ryze E Spell Flux. If the root after the mark is a problem, consider a way to remove crowd control.
Ryze.fight: Reveal Ryze with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage to chip away at his health from maximum range. After Ryze E Spell Flux misses or Ryze W Rune Prison is used, weave in basic attacks to increase your damage and missile recharge rate.
Ryze.laning: Ryze also lacks mana and damage early, so poke him with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage, but don't push the lane toward his turret without vision.
Ryze.combo: When poking, reveal Ryze with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage. When you have an opening to engage, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie, keep Corki E Gatling Gun active as you basic attack, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. If possible, land the third, larger missile as your finisher.
Ryze.escape: Don't rush an engage while the mark from Ryze E Spell Flux remains or Ryze W Rune Prison is ready. Save Corki W Valkyrie as an escape.
Ryze.phase: Corki's base stats are low early, and Ryze also lacks mana and damage, so farm safely while slowing Ryze's growth with poke.
Ryze.teamfight: From the back line, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then deal damage with Corki R Missile Barrage. Aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking, and only engage with Corki W Valkyrie after the enemy's engage tools and crowd control, including Ryze R Realm Warp, have been used.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between Corki and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock the sphere into you and stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage; when low on health, watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early so you can more easily dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, and E Scatter the Weak on foot. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from these abilities, and get health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: First reveal Syndra with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then poke from maximum range with R Missile Barrage. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie and attack with basic attacks while Corki E Gatling Gun is active.
Syndra.laning: Don't push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for an escape. Gradually poke with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and R Missile Barrage while dodging Syndra Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, and E Scatter the Weak.
Syndra.combo: When poking, reveal Syndra with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with R Missile Barrage. If you engage after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, activate E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, then finish with R Missile Barrage. If possible, time the high damage from the third shot to land during your finishing sequence.
Syndra.escape: The moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used is an opportunity to engage with Corki W Valkyrie. Syndra has no mobility ability, so close the gap then; if E Scatter the Weak is still ready, don't use Corki W Valkyrie first and save it as an escape.
Syndra.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build two or three items, use your increased damage, but choose an opening after Syndra E Scatter the Weak has been used to engage.
Syndra.teamfight: Deal damage from the back line with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. Move away from areas covered by several Syndra Q Dark Sphere orbs, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous. Only engage with Corki W Valkyrie after the enemy's engage tools and targeted crowd control, including Syndra E Scatter the Weak, have been used.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range.
TwistedFate.build: Farm safely early to reach your first core item sooner. If you need defense, build magic resistance against Twisted Fate's magic damage, and consider movement speed to leave areas targeted by his area attacks.
TwistedFate.fight: Reveal Twisted Fate with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage to chip away at his health from maximum range. Look to close the gap when the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has been used and Twisted Fate R Destiny is unavailable.
TwistedFate.laning: Don't push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for an escape.
TwistedFate.combo: For poke, first reveal Twisted Fate with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. When an opening to engage appears, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, basic attack with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. The third shot of Corki R Missile Barrage deals heavy damage, so count the shots and time it for the finisher.
TwistedFate.escape: Look to engage after the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has been used and Twisted Fate R Destiny is unavailable. Corki W Valkyrie is your only mobility ability, so don't use it to engage if you may need it to escape.
TwistedFate.phase: The information provided isn't enough to determine who has the advantage at each stage against Twisted Fate.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Deal damage with Corki R Missile Barrage from the back line, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually attacking. If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card is still available, don't engage first with Corki W Valkyrie. Before an objective, use Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to gain vision, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage from beyond a wall or outside enemy vision.

Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you once, move out of the return path. Being hit twice makes it easier for Talon P Blade's End to trigger. When Talon R Shadow Assault is ready, he can escape with stealth, so don't chase recklessly.
Talon.build: Build cheap armor, such as Cloth Armor, early. Talon's damage is physical, so armor is more effective than magic resistance; later, build health as well to counter his lethality. If poke damage keeps getting healed away by Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Talon.fight: Dodge the returning blades from Talon W Rake while poking from maximum range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. After Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy and E Assassin's Path, you have an opportunity to close the gap and retaliate. If you confirm that Talon R Shadow Assault has also been used, you can fight more aggressively.
Talon.laning: When you lack vision, don't push the lane toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for an escape. If Talon roams, share his position and get vision along the jungle paths.
Talon.combo: Your standard poke sequence is to hit Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage. When you have a safe opening to engage, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks while Corki E Gatling Gun is active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Check your missile count so the high damage from the third Corki R Missile Barrage lands as the finisher.
Talon.escape: Engage with Corki W Valkyrie after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and E Assassin's Path have both been used. If Talon R Shadow Assault has also been used, there's less risk of losing him to stealth while chasing. If the engage isn't certain, save Corki W Valkyrie for an escape.
Talon.phase: Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so scale safely and extend the game.
Talon.teamfight: Deal damage with Corki R Missile Barrage from the back line, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually attacking. If Talon dives onto your back line, group with your allies to respond, and use Corki W Valkyrie after Talon's engage ability has been used. Before an objective, use Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to gain vision, then fire Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

Sylas.watch: Sylas E Abscond / Ransom's first dash is less dangerous than his second chain. If the chain hits you, it knocks you up and leaves you open to follow-up attacks, so it’s safer to use Corki W Valkyrie to dodge it. If you’re clipped by Sylas Q Chain Lash, immediately leave the intersection where it explodes after a delay.
Sylas.build: Farm safely and get your first core item quickly. If the health you take off with poke comes back because of Sylas W Kingslayer’s healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. If you need defensive stats, choose magic resistance to counter Sylas’s magic damage.
Sylas.fight: Poke from maximum range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage, and weave in basic attacks to speed up your missile charges. Don’t use Corki W Valkyrie to dive in first until both Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Ransom are down. Once both mobility abilities are down, keep basic attacking with Corki E Gatling Gun active and finish him off.
Sylas.combo: When poking, reveal Sylas with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. When his engage ability is down and you can all-in, use Corki W Valkyrie to go in, basic attack with Corki E Gatling Gun active, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your missile shots so the third, larger missile lands to finish him.
Sylas.escape: Before engaging, make sure both Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Ransom are down. In particular, the window before Sylas E Abscond / Ransom comes back is your chance to close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie. If Sylas E Abscond / Ransom’s second chain is still available, use Corki W Valkyrie to dodge it.
Sylas.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is actually attacking. Right after Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Ransom, focus him with your team to deny him time to heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then keep throwing Corki R Missile Barrage from over a wall or out of vision.

Veigar.watch: If you’re trapped in Veigar E Event Horizon, don’t force your way through the edge; move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Dodge Veigar W Dark Matter to the side by watching its ground indicator, and if your health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Farm safely and get your first core item quickly. If you build resistances against Veigar Q Baleful Strike, Veigar W Dark Matter, and Veigar R Primordial Burst, choose magic resistance over armor.
Veigar.fight: Keep your distance and whittle Veigar down by hitting him with Corki R Missile Barrage after Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb reveals him. Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie, then move and weave in basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active.
Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions to dodge Veigar Q Baleful Strike. Don’t push the wave far without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie to escape.
Veigar.combo: For poke, reveal Veigar with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. If Veigar E Event Horizon is down and you can go in, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, basic attack with Corki E Gatling Gun active, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage timed for the third, larger shot.
Veigar.escape: Your opening to engage Veigar comes after his crowd control, Veigar E Event Horizon, is down. Veigar has no mobility, so use Corki W Valkyrie to close the gap then. But if you’re trapped in Veigar E Event Horizon, save Corki W Valkyrie to escape through the edge.
Veigar.phase: Veigar keeps getting stronger as he gains stacks, so as the game goes on, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon more carefully.
Veigar.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is attacking to reduce their defenses. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then cast Corki R Missile Barrage from over a wall or out of vision. Hold off on using Corki W Valkyrie to go in until the enemy’s crowd control and engage abilities, including Veigar E Event Horizon, are down.

Vex.watch: While Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready, dashing in with Corki W Valkyrie can get interrupted, so go in after the fear is used. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger over distance, so dodge it with a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits and marks you, move toward your allies to prepare for the follow-up dash.
Vex.build: Early on, farm safely and complete your first core item quickly. Prioritize magic resistance over armor to counter Vex’s damage. Also consider movement speed to walk out of telegraphed areas and tenacity to counter her fear.
Vex.fight: Poke with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage on Vex’s revealed position. Fight aggressively when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and Vex W Personal Space’s shield are down. If Vex R Shadow Surge is still available, save Corki W Valkyrie to escape.
Vex.laning: Don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie to escape.
Vex.combo: For poke, reveal Vex with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. When you have a chance to engage, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, basic attack with Corki E Gatling Gun active, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your shots so the high-damage third missile lands to finish her.
Vex.escape: Your window to go in with Corki W Valkyrie is after Vex R Shadow Surge is down and Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear has been used. If Vex W Personal Space’s shield is down too, you have a chance to stick to her and take her out. Until then, save Corki W Valkyrie so you can get away from Vex’s engage.
Vex.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build two or three items, keep dealing damage from the back.
Vex.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are actually attacking. You can reveal an enemy out of vision with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage. If an ally hit by Vex R Shadow Surge is killed, Vex can dash again, so have low-health allies get out of range first.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you if you stay inside, so leave as soon as it’s placed and don’t keep trading inside it. Viktor Q Siphon Power grants a shield and bonus movement speed, so don’t force a chase while its effect is active.
Viktor.build: Farm safely and get your first core item quickly. If you build resistances against Viktor’s damage, choose magic resistance. Movement speed also helps you walk out of Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.fight: Before getting close to Viktor, poke him by hitting Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and following up with Corki R Missile Barrage. Engage with Corki W Valkyrie when Viktor W Gravity Field is down and you can safely close the gap. Once you’re close, move and weave in empowered basic attacks with Corki E Gatling Gun active.
Viktor.laning: Avoid Viktor E Hextech Ray by staying out of line with the wave, and don’t push the wave toward the enemy turret without vision. Save Corki W Valkyrie to escape while poking with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage.
Viktor.combo: When poking, reveal Viktor with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. If Viktor W Gravity Field is down and you can engage, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie, basic attack with Corki E Gatling Gun active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your shots so the third missile’s high damage lands to finish him.
Viktor.escape: If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave the area immediately to avoid being stunned. Engage with Corki W Valkyrie when Viktor W Gravity Field is down and you can avoid the crowd control. If you use Corki W Valkyrie to engage, you won’t have a mobility ability left to escape, so only go in from a safe angle.
Viktor.phase: Viktor P Glorious Evolution’s stacks are permanent, so take advantage of early opportunities to poke safely, but don’t expect the same trades as the game goes on.
Viktor.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your team is attacking. Before using Corki W Valkyrie to go in, make sure the enemy’s engage and crowd control abilities, including Viktor W Gravity Field, are down. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then cast Corki R Missile Barrage from over a wall or out of vision.

Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, he can follow up with more damage, so watch out especially for that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging it, move well to the side. Also move out of the area targeted by Xerath W Eye of Destruction.
Xerath.build: Farm safely to get your first core item quickly. Magic resistance is more useful than armor as a defensive stat, but first consider a way to remove or break free from Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun. The source does not specify a particular first item.
Xerath.fight: At long range, reveal Xerath’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage to poke. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie and trade.
Xerath.laning: Instead of constantly trading back into Xerath’s poke, wait for his mana to run low, then push the lane and call your jungler. When you lack vision, don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Xerath.combo: For poke, reveal Xerath’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. When you go all-in after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, attack with basic attacks while Corki E Gatling Gun is active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. Count your Corki R Missile Barrage shots so the third, high-damage shot lands to finish him.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the window to engage is right after the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb and the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Save Corki W Valkyrie until then, and close the gap with it once you confirm both abilities are down.
Xerath.phase: Corki is strong in the mid to late game once he has two or three items.
Xerath.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. After Xerath is revealed by Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, you can follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage. Hold off on using Corki W Valkyrie to engage until the enemy’s engage tools and crowd control are down.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion restores health and, when empowered, also grants movement speed, so don’t take it and continue an extended trade. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so step back until the effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Farm safely early to get Corki’s first core item sooner. Build magic resistance early against Vladimir’s damage rather than armor. If he is sustaining through your poke with healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Vladimir.fight: Chip away at his health from the edge of your range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage, but save Corki W Valkyrie so you can escape. Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then attack when the pool ends. While Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, you can also use the slow window to close the gap.
Vladimir.laning: If you get a chance to slow Vladimir’s early scaling, poke him with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. Don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Vladimir.combo: For poke, reveal his position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. For an all-in, approach with Corki W Valkyrie after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, weave in basic attacks while Corki E Gatling Gun is active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. The third Corki R Missile Barrage shot deals heavy damage, so count your shots and time it to finish him.
Vladimir.escape: The opportunity to go in with Corki W Valkyrie comes after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is used and the pool ends. Delay your engage if Vladimir E Tides of Blood’s slow could pin you down or while you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague. Save Corki W Valkyrie if you may need to escape.
Vladimir.phase: Corki’s damage comes online in the mid to late game with two or three items, but Vladimir gets harder to deal with the longer he is left unchecked.
Vladimir.teamfight: Use Corki R Missile Barrage from behind, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the enemy your allies are actually attacking. Reveal the enemy’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position. Spread out so several allies aren’t hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague together, and if you are infected, fight again after the effect ends.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado will be ready, so keep your distance until the stacks expire. After he goes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so watch your remaining health. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits, so move out of its path and save Corki W Valkyrie to dodge it.
Yone.build: Farm safely to get your first core item quickly. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus solely on armor or magic resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone, and consider movement speed to get out of its telegraphed area.
Yone.fight: Chip away at his health from the edge of your range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. Keep your distance when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, and don’t jump in just because one of Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed is down. Close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie after his engage options are down.
Yone.laning: While Yone is preparing the tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel, back out of range and poke after the stacks expire. If you lack vision, don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Yone.combo: For poke, reveal his position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. When an opportunity to engage opens, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks while Corki E Gatling Gun is active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. If possible, use the high-damage missile from the third shot to finish him.
Yone.escape: Save Corki W Valkyrie in case Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado or Yone R Fate Sealed threatens you. Before engaging, check which mobility options Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, and Yone R Fate Sealed still have available, and look especially for a window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up.
Yone.phase: Yone is also weak before he gets attack speed, so look for opportunities to poke and pressure his CS from a safe distance.
Yone.teamfight: Deal damage from behind with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the enemy your allies are actually attacking. Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you and build a larger shield, and watch the path of Yone R Fate Sealed and your position in the back line. Don’t go in first with Corki W Valkyrie before Yone’s engage abilities are down.

Zed.watch: If you are marked by Zed R Death Mark, use Corki W Valkyrie to create distance so Zed can’t stack more damage.
Zed.build: Zed’s main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark is physical, so build armor early. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on choices that only add a lot of health.
Zed.fight: Trade gradually from the edge of your range by following up Corki R Missile Barrage on Zed after Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb reveals him. Look for an opening after Zed W Living Shadow disappears or Zed has already repositioned, and close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie if Zed R Death Mark is also down.
Zed.laning: When you lack vision, don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Zed.combo: For poke, reveal Zed with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit him with Corki R Missile Barrage. If you go in after Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are down, approach with Corki W Valkyrie, weave in basic attacks while Corki E Gatling Gun is active, then finish with Corki R Missile Barrage. If possible, time the high-damage third shot to finish him.
Zed.escape: If only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can still escape with Zed R Death Mark, so don’t go in first with Corki W Valkyrie. Engage during the window when both Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are down, and you are outside the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash at the shadow’s location.
Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game, so avoid getting caught alone during that period. Corki should look to the mid to late game, when he has two or three items. In the late game, group with your allies so Zed has no isolated target to pick off.
Zed.teamfight: Deal damage from behind with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the enemy your allies are actually attacking. If Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark are still available, save Corki W Valkyrie and go in only after Zed’s engage options are down. Before an objective, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position.

Zoe.watch: Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is dangerous because of the follow-up after the sleep, so dodge it first. If it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star! Even a missed bubble remains as a trap, so watch out for narrow paths and brush entrances without vision.
Zoe.build: Farm safely to complete your first core item quickly. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance against Zoe’s magic damage, but health helps against the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Dodging the bubble takes priority over buying more items.
Zoe.fight: Reveal Zoe from long range with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage to chip away at her health. When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down and Zoe can’t use Zoe R Portal Jump, you can close the gap and attack with Corki W Valkyrie. If Zoe uses R to move, target the spot where she’ll return.
Zoe.laning: Don’t push the lane toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Zoe.combo: Poke in this order: reveal Zoe’s position with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then hit her with Corki R Missile Barrage. When an opening to engage appears, go in with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun, weave in basic attacks, and finish with R. The third R deals heavy damage, so count your charges and time it to finish the fight.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is an opportunity to engage with Corki W Valkyrie. If Zoe R Portal Jump is also down, wait for Zoe to return to her starting point and target that spot. Don’t use W first if both abilities are available or you may need to escape.
Zoe.phase: Corki comes into his own in the mid to late game as he builds two or three items and deals damage from the backline.
Zoe.teamfight: Deal damage from the backline with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. Look for an engage with Corki W Valkyrie after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Before an objective, use Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb to light up the area, then follow up with R from beyond a wall or outside vision.

Yasuo.watch: If Yasuo hits you with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, his next attack knocks you up with a whirlwind, so move sideways to dodge when his stacks are full. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to approach, and if you’re hit by the knock-up, Yasuo R Last Breath can follow. Against Yasuo W Wind Wall, change your projectile angle or save key abilities until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Complete your first core item quickly by farming safely.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then trade in earnest. Right after Yasuo’s Yasuo Q Steel Tempest whirlwind misses, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so poke with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is still up, change your angle or wait for it to disappear.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to limit the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to approach. Don’t push toward the enemy turret without vision, and save Corki W Valkyrie for escape.
Yasuo.combo: Remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then poke in this order: Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb → Corki R Missile Barrage. Follow the position revealed by Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb with Corki R Missile Barrage. To all-in, engage with Corki W Valkyrie, turn on Corki E Gatling Gun while attacking with basic attacks, and finish with Corki R Missile Barrage.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo launches the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest whirlwind is an opportunity to engage. If Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and Yasuo R Last Breath are down and Yasuo W Wind Wall has disappeared, close the gap with Corki W Valkyrie. Until then, save Corki W Valkyrie to respond to Yasuo’s approach.
Yasuo.phase: Corki is strongest in the mid to late game as he builds two or three items, so get through the early game safely.
Yasuo.teamfight: Deal damage from the back with Corki R Missile Barrage, and aim Corki E Gatling Gun at the target your allies are attacking. In objective fights, reveal the enemy team with Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb, then follow up with Corki R Missile Barrage from over a wall or out of vision. Don’t use Corki W Valkyrie to engage while Yasuo still has his engage and knock-up.
